comment: Every NotSupported case in a committed KHR-GL33 baseline must match exactly one entry (fnmatch pattern). scripts/docs/generate.py fails otherwise. 'kind' is 'extension' (a group for an extension WineMetalGL does not advertise), 'version' (the case needs a newer GL version than the context) or 'test-design' (the CTS reports NotSupported for this combination on every implementation; the reason cites the test code).

entries.reason: ASTC formats need GL_KHR_texture_compression_astc_ldr, which is not advertised.
Stencil texturing needs GL 4.3 (GL_ARB_stencil_texturing is not advertised).
The case runs only on OpenGL 4.1 or newer contexts.

The case pairs a texture target with an access routine or format that the test marks invalid (gl3cTextureSwizzleTests.cpp isTargetSuppByAccess/isTargetSuppByFormat, or a format whose m_minimum_gl_context is above 3.3), so it reports NotSupported on every implementation.
